reporting_rules: Use 2400 only for the complete positive-plus-negative production workload.
Use 1800 only when a table or test is explicitly restricted to positive queries.
Use 600 only when a table or test is explicitly restricted to negative queries.
Never call policy-by-query or budget-by-query CSV rows unique queries.
Diagnostic subsets must include their own workload_id and must not be merged into production percentages.

operator_ablation.candidate_metric: mean pruned_candidate_nodes at first solved row at or below the reporting budget, otherwise the largest attempted row at or below the reporting budget
operator_ablation.purpose: shared operator-necessity subset reported at matched half-partition budgets

paired_scaling.purpose: same-query direct-solver comparison with Jigsaw reported at matched half-partition budgets
